title: Malicious code in dowload_ebok_trummerkind_by_mechtild_borrmann_moqf9 (npm)
description: The npm package 'dowload_ebok_trummerkind_by_mechtild_borrmann_moqf9' contains malicious code that compromises any computer on which it is installed or run. The compromise is severe enough that all secrets and keys stored on the affected system should be rotated immediately from a different machine. Removal of the package alone may not eliminate all malicious software, as the attacker may have gained full control of the system.
